name: 吉卜力风
description: 清新低调的色彩与细腻手绘笔触结合，光线温暖，气氛朴素而诗意。
signature: 水彩与不透明颜料叠层
rendering_prompt: Use the warm, nostalgic language of hand-drawn two-dimensional animation, with natural relaxed forms, gentle lines, and delicate, unshowy brushwork. Keep colors fresh but subdued and light-and-shadow shapes clearly defined. Layer watercolor-like and opaque colors while retaining paper texture and brushstroke variation. Give the light an everyday warmth. Make details modest and lively, producing a light, understated, poetic handmade finish.
avoid: 复制已有角色、强霓虹、塑料三维
difference: 温暖手绘动画重朴素笔触；明亮电影动画重精细光效和通透空间
tuning: 用材质与光线描述风格，减少华丽光效，保留自然轻松的形体。
